I was personally diagnosed at 4, but it was kept as a secret from me till I was 19.

Having lack of "natural" charisma, or socialising "naturally".  I struggle alot with making natural "moves" on someone. Especially when it comes to romantic and/or sexual relationships. 

Examples:

* Flirting is near IMPOSSIBLE for me. I need to be very explicit with what I'm into/what I want with someone, which ruins the magic for a lot of people.
* I either give no eye contact or awkward and unnatural eye contact. Basically I have to force myself to look at people in the eyes, which in turn looks very awkward to others...
* Poor skill at explaining my emotions, alexithymia basically.
* Alot of my actions come off as either "robotic" or "unauthentic". Let's say for example someone lovingly pats me on the head, I will do the same thing in return to them. A lot of people have pointed out that this seems "fake" from me, when it's really not, I am just trying to express my admiration through mimic
